commitMessage:
PWA: Pantauku manifest, orange app icon, automatic updates

- Manifest: id, description, Indonesian lang, portrait, separate 'any'
  and 'maskable' icons; maskable and Apple icons are a white pin on an
  orange tile
- iOS/Android meta tags so the installed app is titled Pantauku
- Updates apply automatically when found within 15s of opening the app
  or when it goes to the background; otherwise a prompt is shown
- Update check runs on login screens too, every 10 minutes and whenever
  the app becomes visible
